Experience.title: Senior Data Engineer (AI Focused / Modern Data Practice)

description.item: Architected and implemented a Databricks-based survey analytics platform processing large-scale consumer research datasets using PySpark-native transformations, dynamic column-definition metadata, and incremental Change Data Feed pipelines, powering downstream analytics and reporting systems.

Led data discovery and architecture sessions across 20+ enterprise clients, translating complex business requirements into scalable ETL pipelines and accelerating onboarding for AI-driven analytics deployments.

Acted as customer-facing technical lead, guiding organizations through data assessment, schema design, and ETL implementation to support AI analytics platforms or knowledge transfer to client-managed infrastructure.

Developed large-scale ingestion and transformation pipelines processing billions of rows for enterprise CPG clients including Beam Suntory, Kimberly-Clark, Wella, General Mills, Coty, and National Beverage, integrating Nielsen, Kantar, IRI, SPINS, and Toluna data sources.
Architected a config-driven ETL platform on Azure + Snowflake, ingesting 40+ API endpoints and 69 Excel mapping definitions through a Medallion architecture, powering Power BI DirectQuery dashboards.
Implemented reusable orchestration logic for dependent API workflows, enabling sequential API retrieval pipelines while minimizing redundant requests through caching and checkpointing.

Provisioned platform infrastructure using Terraform + Terragrunt, managing Azure storage, Snowflake resources, and Azure Function Apps with GitHub Actions CI/CD for automated infrastructure and pipeline deployment.

Designed complex brand tracking analytics pipelines for global Beam Suntory Spirits/RTD programs, implementing multi-wave survey harmonization, weighted metric calculations, and cross-market aggregations across 15+ international markets.

Played a key role in modernizing the company's data infrastructure, transitioning multiple business units and organizations to a centralized Microsoft-based data platform built on SQL Server, Power Query, and automated ETL workflows.
Designed and maintained ETL pipelines for large, complex datasets, enabling standardized ingestion, transformation, and reporting across multiple departments.
Authored and optimized advanced SQL queries and database procedures, improving query performance and enabling scalable analytics for internal reporting systems.
Developed automation tools in C# (.NET Core) and Python (NumPy / Pandas) to streamline data transformation workflows and reduce manual processing.
Built and maintained 80+ Excel automation solutions using VBA and Power Query, enabling business teams to execute repeatable ETL operations, automate reporting, and reduce operational overhead.
Partnered with business stakeholders and operations teams to translate reporting and operational requirements into automated data workflows and analytics tools.

Architected and deployed a full-stack time tracking SaaS (zerve-app) with React 18 + TypeScript frontend, Flask API backend running on AWS Lambda via apig-wsgi, DynamoDB with pluggable PostgreSQL support via repository pattern, and Cognito JWT authentication.
Built an AI-powered document management platform (zerve-legal) for SBA loan processing with LangChain (OpenAI + Anthropic), dynamic form builder, bulk CSV/XLSX import, and multi-role RBAC.
Implemented a 4-layer backend architecture (Controllers, Managers, Services, Database) with repository pattern supporting both DynamoDB and PostgreSQL backends, switchable via environment variable.
Provisioned complete AWS infrastructure using Terraform: S3 + CloudFront (frontend), Lambda + API Gateway (backend), DynamoDB, Cognito, Route53, and ACM for multiple production applications.
Designed GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines with automated linting, testing (180+ unit tests, 30+ integration tests), security scanning, and zero-downtime deployment.

description.item: Founding lead data engineer, responsible for building the initial infrastructure and architecture.

Coordinated with other teams to develop various data models tailored to their specific use cases, then integrated them by enhancing or creating new data pipelines and ETLs.

Experience.title: Data Engineer II - Part Time (Data Analytics Team)

description.item: Orchestrated the establishment of foundational data infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), leveraging BigQuery as the central data warehouse and harnessing the efficiency of AirByte for streamlined data pipeline orchestration.

Set up Hadoop clusters for fast data processing. Created pipelines for data input and managed processing tasks. Used Hadoop tools like HDFS, MapReduce, and Hive to analyze large datasets, extract insights, and inform data-driven decisions.
Devised intricate data models in alignment with diverse use cases identified by the business leadership, ensuring a robust architecture to support decision-making.
Executed seamless implementation of data models using DBT alongside custom Python-based ETL/ELT solutions, driving the transformation and enrichment of data.

Demonstrated proficiency in crafting dynamic insights by harnessing Metabase, leading to the design and deployment of a comprehensive dashboard that catered to the exact informational needs of the business leadership.
Assumed a mentorship and managerial role, effectively guiding and overseeing the professional growth of new team members, fostering a collaborative and knowledge-sharing environment.
